Thought: Let me analyze the chemical equation: Au + 3HNO3 + 4HCl -> HAuCl4 + xNO2 + 3H2O

- H: 3 (from 3HNO3) + 4 (from 4HCl) = 7 on left; 1 (from HAuCl4) + 6 (from 3H2O) = 7 on right ✓
- N: 3 on left (from 3HNO3), x on right (from xNO2) → This means x = 3
- O: 9 (from 3HNO3) on left; 2x (from xNO2) + 3 (from 3H2O) = 2x + 3 on right
- Cl: 4 on left (from 4HCl), 4 on right (from HAuCl4) ✓

For oxygen to be balanced: 9 = 2x + 3
Solving for x: 9 - 3 = 2x
Therefore: 6 = 2x
x = 3

- H: 3 + 4 = 1 + 6 ✓
- N: 3 = 3 ✓
- O: 9 = 2(3) + 3 = 6 + 3 = 9 ✓
